gloss: to reach the age of awareness; to become old enough to understand things

definitions.gloss: to reach the age of awareness; to become old enough to understand the world around one
definitions.explanation: Describes the developmental stage when a young child becomes capable of understanding and remembering their surroundings, typically around ages 3-5. Almost always used with reference to one's earliest memories.

examples.japanese: {物心|ものごころ}ついたとき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧はいなかった。
examples.english: By the time I was old enough to be aware, my father was already gone.

examples.japanese: {物心|ものごころ}つく⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: We moved before I was old enough to remember, so I have no memories of the town where I was born.

examples.japanese: {物心|ものごころ}ついた⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった。
examples.english: I've loved music for as long as I can remember.

notes:
Composed of {物心|ものごころ} (awareness of the world, understanding of things) + つく (to become attached, to develop). A common expression in autobiographical narratives and family stories. {物心|ものごころ} itself is a compound of ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (things) + ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (heart/mind).

Almost always appears in fixed temporal patterns like {物心|ものごころ}ついたとき (when I became aware), {物心|ものごころ}つく⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before I was aware), or {物心|ものごころ}ついた⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧ (around the time I became aware).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {物心|ものごころ}ついたとき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: by the time one was old enough to understand
- {物心|ものごころ}つく⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: before one was old enough to remember
- {物心|ものごころ}ついた⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from as far back as one can remember
- {物心|ものごころ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to develop awareness (with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ particle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: as far as one can remember — focuses on memory rather than developmental stage
- ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧{頃|ころ}: when one was young — a general time reference without the developmental milestone nuance
